issue.title: sase-core check hits 27 pre-existing clippy errors on the collision-policy base
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-df.2.1.1 note #1; its close note #2 records identical clean-base evidence. sase tool run check failed with 27 clippy errors across agent_hold, bead/cli/tests, bead/touch_index, macro_catalog/tests, artifact_ref_commit_budget, gateway/push, and macro_lsp tests. The collision partition and binding tests passed. Reproduce through the governed check in an opened gh:sase-org/sase-core checkout, record the Rust toolchain and exact diagnostics, repair only still-present lint violations, and verify just check (via sase tool run check). Do not run check-full. The landing audit did not rerun the full gate; preserve that distinction and close as superseded if current toolchain/source no longer reproduces. Host-project same-type/all-type searches, last-week sweeps, and active-epic inspection found no matching task or causal active epic; Footprint only owns the separate Symvision exemptions.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The proposing phase reproduced the same 27 deterministic clippy diagnostics both with its change and on clean base 83b010dd; see bob-cli-df.2.1.1 notes #1 and #2.

issue.creation_reason: Phase bob-cli-df.2.1.1 reproduced the same 27 clippy errors with its work and on clean base 83b010dd. The unrelated gate failure needs independent cleanup without blocking collision-quarantine repairs.

evidence.note: Landing triage of bob-cli-df.2.1.4.1 note #1: the repair phase independently reports the same 27 Clippy diagnostics on its tree and clean base 83b010dd, with focused artifact-link and PyO3 tests passing. This is additional affected-phase evidence, not a fresh gate reproduction by this lander. Existing clean-base witness is 83b010dd; no duplicate task.
